list.name: session_id

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM trading.trade_event ORDER BY session_id DESC

list.label: Session
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM trading.trade_event ORDER BY session_id DESC

list.name: setup

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT setup FROM trading.trade_event ORDER BY setup DESC

list.label: Setup
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT setup FROM trading.trade_event ORDER BY setup DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT equity FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ((last_eq - first_eq) / first_eq) * 100 AS return_pct FROM (SELECT argMin(equity, timestamp) AS first_eq, argMax(equity, timestamp) AS last_eq FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup))
SELECT min(drawdown) * 100 AS max_dd FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup)
SELECT sharpe_ratio FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count() AS trades FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IN ('open', 'close') AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup)

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, argMax(equity, timestamp) AS equity FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, min(drawdown) * 100 AS drawdown FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, argMax(zscore, timestamp) AS z FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND zscore IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, concat(ifNull(indicator, 'ema'), ':short:', session_id) AS series, argMax(short_ema, timestamp) AS value FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND short_ema IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, concat(ifNull(indicator, 'ema'), ':long:', session_id) AS series, argMax(long_ema, timestamp) AS value FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND long_ema IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, concat('price:', session_id) AS series, argMax(close_price, timestamp) AS value FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, argMax(position_size, timestamp) AS position FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, argMax(sharpe_ratio, timestamp) AS sharpe FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t
SELECT sum(pnl) AS total_pnl FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event = 'close' AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup)

SELECT timestamp, event, signal, position_side, position_size, fill_price, pnl, equity, drawdown * 100 AS drawdown_pct, exposure_ratio, reason FROM trading.trade_event WHERE event IS NOT NULL AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, avg(api_latency_ms) AS latency FROM trading.ops WHERE type = 'api' AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t
SELECT timestamp, response_code, response_source, api_latency_ms FROM trading.ops WHERE type = 'api' AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, avg(candle_lag_ms) AS lag FROM trading.ops WHERE type = 'tick' AND candle_lag_ms IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t

SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_ms millisecond) AS t, session_id, max(write_buffer_size) AS buf_size FROM trading.ops WHERE type = 'tick' AND write_buffer_size IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) GROUP BY t, session_id ORDER BY t

SELECT timestamp, reconcile_equity_diff, reconcile_position_match, reconcile_correction FROM trading.ops WHERE type = 'reconcile' AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT timestamp, error_message FROM trading.ops WHERE type = 'error' AND session_id IN ($session_id) AND setup IN ($setup) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
